title: Add issue labels and label filtering
goal: Assign short labels to issues through the UI and filter the issue list by one label.

acceptance.description: Labels assigned through the UI survive a full server restart and existing databases upgrade without losing issues.
A selected label filter shows only matching issues and combines with existing search and status filters.
Empty, non-string, overlong, and excessive labels are rejected without writing records.
Existing issue behaviors remain working; omitted patch fields are preserved.

notes: Portable learning task. Choose and record reasonable label defaults. Formal requests belong in GitHub Issues; the controller consumes an approved snapshot.
